text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
How's that, Trainer! I scored an amazing
win!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I put Flower in her place too. This is
proof I've
gro—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wuh, what?!
choice_data_list: おめでとうっっ！！

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: W-well, yes. I did do very well...
choice_data_list: 本当によくやった！！
本当によくやったね！！

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Is something wrong? You're more
energetic than
usual.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Oh!
choice_data_list: 『スプリンターズS』連覇達成だ！
『スプリンターズS』連覇達成だよ！

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now that you've said it, I do remember
winning
first place last year!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I won twice in a row, in a G1 race to
boot!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This is certainly a great feat! My
classmates must
be very pleased with
me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is! I'm a super amazing class

representative!
choice_data_list: すごいことだ！
すごいことだよ！

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course! You can always count on a
class
representative to get results!
choice_data_list: 君ならできると信じてた！
貴方ならできると信じてた！

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Well yes, I am amazing... however! Um, Trainer?
choice_data_list: 本当にすごい！さすが！

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
U-um, I know it's weird coming from
me... but
aren't you praising me a little
too much?
choice_data_list: 世界一のウマ娘だ！
世界一のウマ娘だよ！

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm used to getting compliments, but this
is a little
embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: There are more compliments to go?!
choice_data_list: まだまだ褒め足りない！
まだまだ褒め足りないよ！

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Urk...I see!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This only means I should prepare myself!
I will
accept any and all compliments
from you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes! I am a genius!
choice_data_list: 君はスピードの天才だ！
貴方はスピードの天才！

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm ready for the next one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as I prepare myself to hand out
about 1,000
extra compliments...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'm ready for the next one!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder what those two are doing?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I only dropped by to say
congratulations... Should
I come back
later?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll just whisper it... Congratulations on
the
successive win, Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I'll need any more
compliments for a
while. I feel like I can
just about run anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'll do a little too well next time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What should I do for the next race?
With her
amazing accomplishment this
time around, the
sky's the limit!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! 1,200 meters ag—
choice_data_list: なら次は1600mに挑戦しよう！
なら次は1600mに挑戦しましょう！

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wait! Did you just say 1,600 meters?!
That can
only mean one thing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's 400 meters longer than her
specialty... but I
know she can win it!
choice_data_list: 『マイルCS』に乗り込むぞ！
『マイルCS』に乗り込もう！

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wooo! Finally, we're on the road to mile
races!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's great! This feels like winning twice
in a row
all over again!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You just leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'll be taking that champion spot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And thus we decide our next race would
be the
Mile Championship!
